sql: SELECT t2.points, CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college_score_annual AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.college_identifier WHERE t2.annual = 2015 AND t1.college_identifier = 100

SELECT DISTINCT t1.nation_label FROM nation AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.identifier = t2.nation_identifier INNER JOIN college_annual AS t3 ON t2.identifier = t3.college_identifier WHERE t3.annual = 2013 AND t3.learner_tally * 100 > (SELECT AVG(learner_tally) FROM college_annual) * 98

SELECT SUM(t1.learner_tally) - SUM(CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100) FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Harvard University' AND t1.annual BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Harvard University' AND t1.annual = 2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Stanford University' AND t1.annual = 2011

SELECT t1.learner_tally - CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Emory University' AND t1.annual = 2011

SELECT n.nation_label, CAST(a.learner_tally * a.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS a INNER JOIN college AS c ON a.college_identifier = c.identifier INNER JOIN nation AS n ON n.identifier = c.nation_identifier WHERE a.annual = 2011 AND a.college_identifier = 23
